d: On 14 November 2026, a sleeper bus operating under Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann’s free Tirth Yatra scheme jumped the divider on NH-54 in Tarn Taran and collided with another pilgrim bus, killing four devotees. The buses were part of the scheme launched on 27 November 2023 that provides free travel, stay, food and medical support to Punjab residents aged 50 and above for visits to major religious sites across India.
